name: Ailunce HA2
notes: Figures sourced from Miklor HA2 review (miklor.com/COM/Review_HA2.php) and ailunce.com product page. 1024 channels / 16 zones / 64 ch per zone confirmed on both sources. Channel name length 12 chars confirmed from Miklor: 'The LCD displays up to 12 character channel names.' Official FCC-labeled TX is 144-148 / 420-450 MHz US. Extended TX (VHF 136-174, UHF 400-480) is available via app programming on this HT family and required for GMRS (462-467 MHz) and MURS (151-154 MHz) operation. AM mode declared for airband receive; the HA2 explicitly supports AM reception across the airband. Codeplugger AM channel mode is emitted for airband RX-only assignments. The FM Broadcast and Airband bands overlap (108-115 MHz); validation accepts any matching band so the overlap is harmless.
